title: Duppañño
text: 2. Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami ||la-pe || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3. Duppañño eḷamūgo duppañño eḷamūgo ti bhante vuccati || kittāvatā nu kho bhante Duppañño eḷamūgo ti vuccatī ti || || 4. Sattannaṃ kho bhikkhu bojjhaṅgānam abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā duppañño eḷamūgo ti vuccati || || Katamesaṃ sattannaṃ [page 100] 100 Bojjhaṅga-Saṃyuttam XLVI. Imesaṃ kho bhikkhu sattannaṃ bhojjhaṅgānam abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā Duppañño eḷamūgo ti vaccatī ti || ||
